J U D G M E N T
KURIAN, J.                       
1.
The  issue  in  these  appeals  pertains  to  the  question 
whether the  proceeds generated from the sale of scrap would be 
included in the total turnover.
2.
In the recent decision of this Court in  Commissioner of 
Income Tax Vs. Punjab Stainless Steel Industries & Ors. reported 
in [2014] 364 ITR 144 (SC) it has been held that sale proceeds 
generated from the sale of scrap would not be included in the 
total turnover for the purpose of deduction under Section 80HHC 
of the Income Tax Act, 1961.
3. The appeals are allowed in terms of the judgment referred to 
above.
